The proof handles common factors, intersection points, and infinite values; 11,544 numerical checks are supplementary only.

originality.rationale: Originality attaches to the complete global quotient normal form, global rational-map-degree divisibility, exact minimal ambiguity degree, and arbitrary-location finite-sample transition. The established 2024 source already proves the qualitative two-circle uniqueness dichotomy, constructs rational-angle nonuniqueness, and observes a local Taylor-order divisibility; these are not claimed new. Full related primary materials were inspected, and searches did not reveal the stronger combined classification. Residual risk of an earlier invariant-theoretic formulation is disclosed.
residual_risks: The cyclic rational-map invariant description could have appeared in earlier geometric function theory in other terminology; historical priority remains provisional.
The 2024 paper already contains the qualitative angle dichotomy and a local degree-related Taylor-order obstruction; neither should be characterized as newly discovered.
The finite sample bound is sufficient and geometry-sharp in the angle/degree variable, not proved optimal in number of samples.

value.rationale: A complete classification of all rational-angle polynomial phase ambiguities is a natural endpoint to the 2024 two-circle qualitative theorem. It converts an existence-only exceptional case into a sharp global degree divisibility law and exact degree threshold, plus deterministic phaseless recovery from arbitrary distinct points. These have structural significance in finite-dimensional complex phase retrieval; no globally minimal sample budget or stability improvement is asserted.
